title: QIAseq FastSelect 5s, 16s, 23s Fragmentation
author: Opentrons
materials: After this protocol is finished the plate should be removed and placed on a thermocycler according to FastSelect 5s/16s/23s, Table 3.

steps.title: Place diluted RNA plate
steps.instruction: Place the diluted RNA plate on the temperature module located at site 7.

steps.title: Place Mastermix plate
steps.instruction: Place the Mastermix plate on the temperature module located at site 10 and adjust the MasterMix volume in the protocol according to the selected RNA volume.

steps.title: Transfer plate to thermocycler
steps.instruction: When the protocol is finished, remove the plate and place it on a thermocycler following the FastSelect 5s/16s/23s conditions described in Table 3.
